contentText: US President Donald Trump will deliver his State of the Union speech to Congress on Tuesday, possibly outlining a case for US military intervention in Iran and renewing a push to reinstate his global tariff regime. On the domestic front, the president may discuss the rising cost of living, his administration's agressive immigration tactics and the unfolding scandal related to convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.
